items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: He was playing in the same time, but he was playing with my daddy before Oliver.

ctx.x: Yeah, he went even before John. Yeah.
He had went and come back and then left again with King Oliver band. Yeah.
And he was out on the road with that. I guess I heard that once probably Paul or somebody told us and I forgot about it. Well, Paul was in the band.

items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: And then the last Cornet Press was King Oliver. Empire. That was his best.

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: That's all in there. You got it again? That's all in there.
Yeah. And then the last Cornet Press was King Oliver. Empire. That was his best. Then he took six.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: When Louis, when Joe Oliver sent for Louis, for Louis. I played that dance out there at the fire ground.

ctx.x: When Louis, when Joe Oliver sent for Louis, for Louis. I played that dance out there at the fire ground. Oh yeah. But I played with Kid Rene.
Good luck, alright. How was he on the top? Oh, the greatest. I heard him in the late years when he, you know, he started sick and wasn't... He was going down, yeah.
